items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: Well he was playing second with me when he died. He was playing my band when he died.

ctx.x: Lil' Lawrence Toker. Toker. Well he was playing second with me when he died. He was playing my band when he died. He died on the 4th of July. Here in town? Right. Right there. Right on St. Claude and St. Philip.
Do you remember when he died of? What his trouble was? No I know. I never got to know him. I just wondered.

items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: I had the old musicians with me. ... I had all old musicians. Lil' Orange Toker and me was the two youngest fellas.

ctx.x: Soon after you started? That's right. Who else was in there in a band?

I had the old musicians with me. Really? That's right, I had old man granny, Alphonse Pico, Johnny Dave, Lil' Orange Toker, Gassoun, you remember Gassoun, you got to. I had all old musicians. Lil' Orange Toker and me was the two youngest fellas. I mostly worked with old fellas, I mean when I started, I mean, most old fellas.
And Toker was the carnet player?
